title: Wiki note frontmatter
description: A note as LLM-Wiki-V2 (llmwiki2) writes it (an OKF v0.2 concept of type Note), plus the governance fields the curator adds on the pull-request branch and the verification stamp added when Muthu approves the pull request. Unknown keys are preserved, as OKF asks and as llmwiki2 does on rewrite.

type.description: llmwiki2 writes Note; raw copies are type Source and use source.schema.json

id.description: Stable note id written by llmwiki2

description.description: One-line summary; llmwiki2 routes and indexes by it

by.description: OKF actor; llmwiki2 writes its own producer string

id.description: Footnote key; llmwiki2 numbers them s1, s2, ...

resource.description: Bundle path of the raw copy (type Source) or an absolute URL

previous_version.description: llmwiki2: archived copy of the body a merge replaced

kind.description: Extension: the page type in this wiki's ontology, set by the curator (default Concept); independent of the folder, which is the topic

status.description: OKF lifecycle; the curator sets draft or stable before review

stale_after.description: OKF lifecycle; default by kind in ontology/node-types.yaml

verified.description: OKF trust; stamped on the pull-request branch when Muthu approves the review, never by the writer

classification.description: Extension: only public knowledge may enter wiki/

aliases.description: Other names the graph builder merges into this node; Obsidian and Quartz read the same key

relations.description: Extension: typed edges for the graph builder; See-also links and folder membership remain untyped edges

canonical_essay.description: Extension: the muthub.org page this note summarizes, if any; that page stays canonical
